## Personality

Jane is characterized as a steady and sensible individual. She is motivated by a desire to devote her entire life to teaching, intending never to marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018)_

## History

Jane passed the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside her fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates, performing pretty well. She later attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), where she studied domestic science and lived in a boarding house alongside other local students. After starting her studies, she visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby, bringing news about the Avery scholarship. By the end of her time at Queen's, Jane successfully carried off the honors in her domestic science course.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are longtime friends and fellow classmates who travel to town together to take their entrance examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) under Miss Stacy's guidance. While living in town for their studies, Jane visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house alongside [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby, bringing news about the Avery scholarship. This revelation inspires [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to pursue ambitious new goals during her time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy).

- Friend of — longtime friends and fellow students  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P2](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0002)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane.md)

Jane and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are friends within the same social group who attend concerts together and offer mutual sympathy. They share a close connection through their common circle of schoolmates as they navigate their youth in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their bond remains a source of steady companionship throughout their shared studies and social outings.

- Friend of — friends who attend concerts and share sympathy together  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)</sub>
